caption: Hebrews directly applies Chronicles’ father-son promise to Jesus. The link is strong—but it repeats the same Davidic promise already made in Samuel.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Another promise about God’s Son? God promises to be a father to David’s heir. Hebrews later quotes these words about Jesus.
